displayAddress: Hindmarsh Lofts, 25 Kings Road, Reading, Berkshire, RG1
description:
A spacious and exceptional two-bedroom New York loft-style apartment, originally created by Highfield Developments in 2014, occupying a desirable first-floor position within this exclusive boutique development in the heart of Reading Town Centre.
Offering over 1000sq. ft. (93.8sq. M.) of living accommodation and a sophisticated blend of contemporary design, Art Deco-inspired styling and high-quality finishes, this unique apartment is ideally positioned for commuters, professionals and those looking to downsize or a second home. Reading Train Station is a short walk away, providing a direct connection to London Paddington in under 25 minutes.
The generously proportioned accommodation centres around an impressive open-plan living and entertaining space, complemented by a stylish, high-specification fitted kitchen with a range of integrated appliances. The living area opens onto a private balcony overlooking the quieter rear of the development, creating an attractive space to relax or entertain.
There are two well-appointed double bedrooms, both benefiting from fitted wardrobes. The principal bedroom enjoys the added luxury of a designer wet room, while a further contemporary bathroom serves the remainder of the apartment.
The property is equipped with a host of premium features, including underfloor heating in both bathrooms, CAT 5 cabling, an integrated sound system throughout and a tiled television in the main bathroom.
Further benefits include lift access and a secure gated allocated parking space—an increasingly sought-after feature in such a central location.
Combining stylish interiors, thoughtful technology and an enviable town-centre location, this distinctive apartment offers a rare opportunity to acquire a high-quality home within easy reach of London. The property is offered for sale with no onward chain.

Location:
Located in the heart of the town centre on the Kings Road the property is ideally suited for the commuter that needs easy access to the train station which serves direct access in only 25 minutes to London by train, with trains running every five minutes or so. Reading also has easy links by road or rail to Maidenhead, Swindon, Oxford, Basingstoke, Heathrow and farther afield. Beyond the hive of commercial activity, Reading is nestled in the heart of Royal Berkshire offering beautiful riverside walks on the Thames and tow path ambles on the Kennet and Avon canals and with the nearby Berkshire Downs and Chilterns, beautiful countryside is never far away. Reading offers a rich mix of shops and markets. In the heart of the town, The Oracle combines chic boutiques with Riverside dining and entertainment options and within a minute's walk there are many high-street favourites including John Lewis and Marks & Spencer. There are restaurants, cafes and brasseries to suit every taste in Reading.
